projectContext: Sprint 23 addresses remaining test infrastructure gaps after Sprints 13-22 established ~197 stories of coverage. Key targets: Research clients (1,222 LOC, 0 tests), compilation mode edge cases (667 LOC), test marker distribution (only 4.3% have explicit markers), subdirectory conftest.py files for test_agents/ and others, SABR stall detection edge cases, XML/EDL export special characters, config section validation tests. This sprint focuses on test infrastructure quality and CI/CD optimization rather than module coverage.

userStories.title: Add SABR stall detection edge case tests
userStories.notes: 22 tests added in tests/test_downloader_stall_detection.py. AC1: 3 tests for timeout threshold (triggers after threshold, uses 60s default, no stall when output continues). AC2: 3 tests for timer reset (stderr resets, stdout resets via source inspection, no reset without output). AC3: 2 tests for concurrency (independent timers per process, thread safety via source inspection). AC4: 4 tests for resume-on-retry (partial files cleaned, --no-continue not in source, config supports resume, all partial patterns recognized). AC5: 4 tests for metadata vs progress (metadata/warning/progress/mixed all reset timer). Plus 6 edge case tests. All 22 tests pass in 39s.
acceptanceCriteria: Test stall detector triggers after exact timeout threshold (60s default)
Test stall detector resets timer on any subprocess output
Test stall detector handles concurrent downloads without false positives
Test resume-on-retry correctly continues from last completed fragment
Test stall detector distinguishes metadata output from download progress

userStories.title: Add XML export special character handling tests
userStories.notes: 32 tests added in tests/test_otio_xml_export.py::TestXMLSpecialCharacterHandling. AC1: 3 tests for ampersand escaping in clip names. AC2: 4 tests for quote escaping (double, single, mixed). AC3: 5 tests for angle bracket escaping (<, >, pairs, HTML-like tags). AC4: 5 tests for long paths (200+, 250, nested, long filename, boundary). AC5: 11 tests for Unicode (CJK, Japanese, Korean, emoji, Arabic RTL, Hebrew RTL, Cyrillic, European accents, mixed). Edge cases: 4 tests (encoding declaration, pathurl format, unicode passthrough, combined). Note: escape_xml() is used for clip <name> elements; pathurl uses format_path_url() which preserves raw paths per DaVinci Resolve requirements. All 32 tests pass in 0.57s.
acceptanceCriteria: Test XML export escapes ampersands in file paths correctly
Test XML export escapes quotes in metadata fields correctly
Test XML export escapes angle brackets in clip names correctly
Test XML export handles Windows paths exceeding 200 characters
Test XML export handles Unicode filenames (CJK, emoji, RTL) correctly
